title: SB1334 (112th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 10; Title 33; Title 38; Title 39; Title 40; Title 50 and Title 70, relative to weapons.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Chaptered, 2021-05-28; official copy via the Internet Archive snapshot 20260514164847 of https://publications.tnsosfiles.com/acts/112/pub/pc0554.pdf (LegiScan doc 2410146))
provenance.note: Chaptered, Public Chapter 554 (approved 2021-05-28), the "Second Amendment Privacy and Protection Act of 2021." Sections 4-6 conform TCA 39-17-1314(h)-(i) to cover registry suits. Effective July 1, 2021.

operative_text:
SECTION 2 (new TCA 39-17-1367): (b) A state or local government entity, official, employee, or agent shall not knowingly create or maintain any firearm registry with the intent to record the possession or ownership of a firearm or firearm accessory by individuals or non-governmental entities.
SECTION 2 (new TCA 39-17-1367): (c) A violation of subsection (b) is a Class E felony.
SECTION 2 (new TCA 39-17-1367): (e) A violation of subsection (b) may result in a civil action under § 39-17-1314(9)-(i).
SECTION 2 (new TCA 39-17-1367): (f) A violation of subsection (b) by a state or local entity shall result in loss of funding from the state for the following fiscal year and any subsequent fiscal year during which the violation occurs.
SECTION 3 (TCA 39-17-1314(g)): (ii) The creation or maintenance of a record, database, registry, or collection of records, in violation of § 39-17-1367, by a state or local government entity, official, employee, or agent.
